name: existential-seed-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; cp --remove-destination seed-audit-models/p4.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/seed-audit-p4-models.ts; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; set +e; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.existential-seed.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; TYPES=$?; bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa/existential-seed.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed-witness.test.ts research/bapa/witness-value-proxies.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed-public.test.ts research/bapa/counted-seed.test.ts research/bapa/sum-seed.test.ts research/bapa/native-tuple-seed.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; TESTS=$?; bun research/bapa/candidate-seed-audit.ts research/bapa/seed-audit-no-lost.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/audit.log" 2>&1; AUDIT=$?; bun research/bapa/assert-witness-audit.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/witness-audit.log" 2>&1; WITNESS=$?; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < seed-audit-models/existential-message.txt > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1; LINT=$?; printf 'types=%s tests=%s audit=%s witness=%s commitlint=%s\n' "$TYPES" "$TESTS" "$AUDIT" "$WITNESS" "$LINT" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/checks.txt"; test "$TYPES$TESTS$AUDIT$WITNESS$LINT" = 00000
